xBRIEFInfo.description: Coarse progress lines inside ts:check-lane so a long task check is observable without stopping it.

narratives.Description: feat(check): emit coarse percent/count progress from ts:check-lane during the vitest suite. A parent that snapshots the log mid-run must see a later band than the #3188 start line without stopping the process.
narratives.Origin: Ingested from https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/3470. Operator swarm 2026-08-18 through-merge cohort with #3469 and #3454.
narratives.Overview:
After the #3188 start-of-suite log line, the TypeScript suite prints almost nothing until it finishes. A parent that snapshots the log cannot tell whether the suite is 10 percent done, stuck, or still healthy.

#3188 already logs start of the suite. This story logs progress inside the suite. Prefer vitest's own reporter/hook if it can emit percent-complete without a custom runner. Else a thin wrapper that counts completed files. Line-buffered. Windows + Grok Build capture (#1353) in scope: one line per tick, no pipes in the wrapper.

Out of scope: making the suite faster; SHA suite stamp/resume (#3187); moving more work out of the suite; per-test live UI / TTY spinner.
narratives.UserStory: As an agent running task check, I want coarse progress lines at 10% or 20% of known files or tests, so that I can tell a long suite is healthy without interrupting it.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Find where ts:check-lane invokes vitest at packages/core/src/ts-check-lane/run-lane.ts. 2. Emit flushed progress lines at 10 percent or 20 percent of known work, naming the lane, percent, and file or test count. 3. Prefer vitest reporter/hook; do not dump every test name; do not change pass/fail. 4. Tests in run-lane.test.ts covering cadence + flush. 5. CHANGELOG. Tracking: #3470.

items.title: Emit coarse flushed progress during the vitest suite

narrative.Acceptance: Given ts:check-lane is running the vitest suite, when known work advances through each 10% or 20% band, then stdout emits one flushed line naming the lane, percent, and count (files or tests). A log snapshot mid-run shows a later band than the #3188 start line.

x-directive/evidence.pointer: task check 2026-08-18 emitted ts:check-lane 20/40/60/80/100% (202/404/606/808/1010 files) after the #3188 start line; PR 3475 merged 1907fe769c3a240321213844da4c79b98805ad43

items.title: Progress is line-buffered and silent on pass/fail

narrative.Acceptance: Given the progress reporter, when a tick fires, then the line is flushed immediately (no pipe wrapper). Pass/fail of the suite is unchanged. The reporter does not dump every test name.

x-directive/evidence.pointer: packages/core/src/ts-check-lane/progress.test.ts writeFlushedLine; progress-reporter.test.ts; task check 1004 files / 14058 passed, 6 files / 149 skipped, 0 failed

narrative.Acceptance: Given the ship, when tests run, then run-lane.test.ts covers at least two ticks and a flush. CHANGELOG [Unreleased] cites #3470.
